generator: sky_scan --profile <eaw|foc|remake> --game-root <GAME_ROOT> [--mod-root <REMAKE_MOD>] --report <OUT>/sky-<profile>.json --inventory <OUT>/sky-<profile>-fragment.json; profiles[] below is each fragment parsed verbatim in eaw, foc, remake order
provenance: Logical VFS paths, authored names, SHA-256 digests and counts only. No install roots, no original bytes, no non-texture material values, no captures.
limits: CPU measurement of declared sky references and decoded ALO surfaces. It renders nothing, admits no shader, and says nothing about original appearance. Families come from the P1-02 descriptor bundle by exact case-insensitive stem match; an unmatched stem (for example *.fxo) is not_in_descriptor_bundle and is not guessed.

profiles.scope: CPU-only sky model surface/shader ledger; measures material families, renders nothing, qualifies no shader and claims no visual fidelity

descriptor_bundle.match: authored shader stem with a case-insensitive .fx removed, compared case-insensitively to effects[].name; no match is not_in_descriptor_bundle

profiles.chain_class_rule: attach bone to root: invalid, then nearest billboard bone, then any stored-hidden bone, then any non-proper-rigid transform, then identity if every transform is exactly identity (or no bone) else rigid_static
profiles.model_selection_rule: assets::resolve_map: land map Land_Model_Name else Model_Name; space map Space_Model_Name else Model_Name

aggregates.vertex_colour_format_rule: format-name observation: stored vertex format name ends in C
